title: Melody Olowo
text:
Bio
My name is Oyinloluwa Melody Olowo, and I am an international student from Lagos, Nigeria, pursuing an Honors in Economics. While my academic interests focus on economic analysis and policy formation, I am also deeply interested in marketing and consumer behavior. I have practical experience in customer service and developing marketing strategies. Outside of my studies and career, I enjoy outdoor runs, baking, and reading!
